fullDescription: A cinematic, high-end editorial style guide characterized by deep-black backgrounds (#000000), ivory typography (#F4EFE6), and muted gold accents (#D4AF7A). This design system utilizes a sophisticated pairing of Cormorant Garamond for display serifs and Inter for functional UI elements. The layout features full-width immersive bands, large-scale dramatic typography, and glassmorphism-inspired floating cards. It is optimized for luxury travel, high-end hospitality, premium real estate, and portfolio showcases where atmospheric storytelling is paramount. Key features include grayscale-to-color image transitions, subtle hover scales, and generous negative space that emphasizes visual hierarchy.

structured.summary: A dark, immersive cinematic design system using an ivory-on-black color palette with gold accents, combining dramatic serif typography with minimalist sans-serif UI components for a premium, editorial feel.

style.description: The style is defined by a high-contrast 'Luxury Dark' theme. Primary font is Cormorant Garamond (Serif) for titles and emotional copy, while Inter (Sans-Serif) handles metadata and interactive elements. Colors are strictly limited to Black (#000000), Ivory (#F4EFE6), and Gold (#D4AF7A). Animations are slow and deliberate, using long durations (1000ms) for image transitions and cubic-bezier (0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for button states. Elements often feature very thin borders (1px) with low opacity (8-15%) to create depth without clutter.
style.prompt:
### Color Palette
- **Primary Background**: #000000 (Black)
- **Primary Text**: #F4EFE6 (Ivory)
- **Accent/Action**: #D4AF7A (Gold)
- **Hairlines/Borders**: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) or rgba(244, 239, 230, 0.15)

### Typography
- **Display Serif (Titles)**: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif. Weights: 300, 400. Sizes: 80px to 200px. Leading: 0.95. Use italics for emotional emphasis.
- **Functional Sans (UI)**: 'Inter', sans-serif. Weights: 300, 400, 500. 
- **Eyebrows**: Inter, 12px, 500 weight, 0.3em letter-spacing, uppercase, with a preceding glyph (e.g., ▸).
- **Button Text**: Inter, 13px, 500 weight, 0.25em letter-spacing, uppercase.

### Micro-Interactions & Animations
- **Image Hovers**: Transition from grayscale (50%) to full color over 1000ms. Scale up slightly (1.05).
- **Buttons**: Hollow 1px border. On hover, background fills to #F4EFE6 and text becomes #000000 with a 0.4s cubic-bezier transition.
- **Entry**: Use a pulse animation (opacity 40% to 100%) for scroll cues.
- **Form Inputs**: Border transitions from 15% opacity ivory to 100% ivory on focus.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout consists of high-impact vertical sections. It uses 'hero bands' with full-width imagery and centered content, followed by grid-based exploratory cards, and concluding with a centered, floating reservation form.

prompts.prompt: Create a 95vh height hero section. Background: Black with a 20% opacity centered image. Content: A centered stack consisting of an eyebrow (0.3em spacing), a massive title ('Cormorant Garamond', size 140px+, leading 0.95), and a small max-width (2xl) italic paragraph. Use a pulse-animated scroll-down arrow at the bottom center.

Design a grid of 4 cards with an aspect ratio of 4:5. Each card: Background image at 60% opacity with a black-to-transparent linear gradient overlay (bottom-to-top). Contents: Bottom-aligned text including a title, metadata in Inter (uppercase, small), and a thin gold accent line (50px wide). On hover: Image scales 1.05 and a hidden border becomes visible in Gold (#D4AF7A).

Develop full-width bands (80vh height). Background: Image with 50% opacity, grayscale by default, turning to color on hover. Overlay: Black-to-transparent gradient from left to right. Content: Left-aligned container with an eyebrow, large display title (100px), a checklist of features with gold icons, and a large primary button.

Center a high-density form inside a black-background card with a 1px border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)). Padding: 80px. Background of the section should have a blurred, low-opacity image (30% grayscale) to create depth. Inputs: 1px bordered boxes with 20px padding and Inter font at 14px.

special_ui_components.prompt: Style: border 1px solid #F4EFE6; background: transparent; color: #F4EFE6; font: Inter, 13px, 500, uppercase; tracking: 0.25em; padding: 18px 36px. Hover: background-color: #F4EFE6; color: #000000; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

special_ui_components.description: A portrait card with hidden interactions and deep overlays.
special_ui_components.prompt: Structure: Aspect-ratio 4:5; Overflow: hidden; Relative positioning. Overlay: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.85) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.4) 100%). Inner content: flex-col; justify-end; p-8. Elements: Title (3xl, serif), Subtitle (Inter, 10px, 0.3em tracking), Gold line (50x1px). Interaction: group-hover scale-105; group-hover border-color: #D4AF7A.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Use italics for at least one word in every major heading to maintain the cinematic/editorial feel. MUST: Maintain a minimum horizontal padding of 8vw for all main content. MUST NOT: Use any bright colors or shadows; depth is achieved via gradients and opacity. MUST NOT: Use sans-serif for long-form narrative text.
